title: Software update
description: Updates are checked automatically. Download and restart only when you choose.

channel.label: Stable channel
channel.configured: Automatic checks are enabled for this build.
channel.notConfigured: Online updates are disabled in this build.

download.ready: Update verified. Restart when you are ready.
download.failed: Could not download or verify the update

install.saving: Saving your work and installing the verified update. Do not close the application.
install.failed: Could not save your work or install the update
install.runningTasks: Finish or cancel background tasks before restarting.

unavailable: The updater is unavailable. Retry the check to reconnect.

failure.network: The update server could not be reached. Check your connection and retry.
failure.signature: The downloaded package failed signature verification and will not be installed. Check for updates again.
failure.metadata: The release metadata is invalid for this platform. Check again later or contact support.
failure.installation: Installation failed. Check disk space and permissions before retrying.
failure.internal: The updater encountered an internal error. Restart Knovum and check again.
